records.question: 订单明细一共有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt FROM order_items

records.question: 数据库里一共有多少个客户?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customer_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_name) AS distinct_customer_name
FROM customers

records.question: 2014 年一共下了多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT substr(order_date,1,4) AS yr, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt FROM orders GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

records.question: 2014 年销售额最高的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT c.country AS country, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_cnt
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 三个商品大类各自的销售额和总利润是多少?
records.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN i.sales IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_sales_rows FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_sales DESC

records.tags: 多表/聚合/时间/枚举陷阱
records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS sales,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS profit,
       SUM(i.quantity) AS qty
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON g.country = c.country AND g.region = c.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym;

records.question: Consumer 类型的客户有多少个?
records.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_cnt FROM customers GROUP BY segment ORDER BY customer_cnt DESC

records.question: 平均折扣最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, ROUND(AVG(oi.discount), 4) AS avg_discount FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY avg_discount DESC

records.question: 利润为负的亏损明细有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loss_rows, ROUND(SUM(profit),2) AS total_loss, ROUND(MIN(profit),2) AS min_profit FROM order_items WHERE profit < 0

records.question: 运费最高的 5 行明细,列出行号和运费。
records.sql: SELECT row_id, shipping_cost FROM order_items ORDER BY shipping_cost DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: 美国的客户有多少个?
records.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'United States') AS us_customers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'United States') AS us_customers_with_orders

records.question: 2013 年 12 月的总销售额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, COUNT(*) AS items
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id

records.question: 下单次数最多的 3 个客户,列出客户编号和订单数。

records.question: Technology 大类平均每行明细的销售额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_cnt, AVG(oi.sales) AS avg_sales, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Technology'

records.question: 折扣不低于 0.3 的明细有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN discount >= 0.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_ge_03, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN discount >= 0.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*), 2) AS pct FROM order_items

records.question: 每种配送方式各有多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT ship_mode, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders GROUP BY ship_mode ORDER BY order_cnt DESC

records.question: 数量小于等于 0 的异常明细有哪些行号?

records.question: 各市场的总利润分别是多少?
records.sql: SELECT g.market, ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS total_profit, COUNT(i.row_id) AS items, ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region GROUP BY g.market ORDER BY total_profit DESC

records.question: 2013 年 3 月亚太市场有多少订单?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region

records.question: 2014 年每个季度的销售额分别是多少?
records.sql: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1 AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

records.question: 2013 和 2014 两年各自的总销售额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_date) AS yr, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) IN ('2013','2014')
GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin,
       COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL AND oi.sales <> 0
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC

records.question: 哪个商品子类的利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最低?
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales, SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY profit_margin ASC

records.question: Corporate 客户在 2014 年下了多少张订单,平均每张订单金额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, AVG(order_sales) AS avg_order_amount, SUM(order_sales) AS total_sales
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.sales) AS order_sales
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate' AND o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
)

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(sales) AS median_sales, MAX(n) AS n FROM t
WHERE rn IN ((n+1)/2, (n+2)/2)

records.question: 每种订单优先级各有多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT order_priority, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_priority ORDER BY order_count DESC

records.question: 2015 年 7 月到 12 月的总销售额是多少?

records.question: First Class 配送方式的平均运费是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT o.ship_mode,
       COUNT(*) AS item_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.shipping_cost), 4) AS avg_ship_cost_per_item,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.shipping_cost), 2) AS total_ship_cost
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.ship_mode
ORDER BY avg_ship_cost_per_item DESC

records.question: 销售额缺失(sales 为空)的明细有哪些行号?

records.question: 三个商品大类各有多少张订单(按订单号去重)?

FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category

records.question: 2014 年按月的利润趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS profit,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales), 1) AS margin_pct,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN oi.profit < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_items
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym

records.question: 按配送方式统计总销售额。
records.sql: SELECT o.ship_mode, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(sales) FROM order_items), 2) AS pct FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.ship_mode ORDER BY total_sales DESC

records.question: 没有任何商品明细的订单有几张?
records.sql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders) AS total_orders,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_items) AS orders_with_items,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id)) AS orders_without_items;

records.question: 折扣正好为 0 的明细有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_discount_zero, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items) AS total_rows, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items), 2) AS pct FROM order_items WHERE discount = 0;

records.question: 库里最早和最晚的订单日期分别是哪天?
records.sql: SELECT MIN(order_date) AS earliest, MAX(order_date) AS latest, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders

records.question: 累计消费总额最高的 3 个客户,列出客户编号和消费总额。
records.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.segment, c.country, ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE i.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_id
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 3;

records.question: 各国家的总利润分别是多少?
records.sql: SELECT c.country AS 国家, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS 总利润, COUNT(*) AS 明细行数, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS 总销售额 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY 总利润 DESC

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的市场是哪个?
records.sql:
SELECT g.market,
       SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales,
       SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin,
       COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY g.market
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC;

records.question: Technology 大类 2014 年的总销售额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'Technology'
  AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014';

records.question: 平均利润为负的商品子类有哪些?列出子类和平均利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit, ROUND(AVG(oi.profit), 2) AS avg_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE oi.profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING AVG(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY avg_profit

records.question: 2014 年总利润为负(亏损)的商品子类,按亏损金额从小到大列出子类和总利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS items
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2014-12-31'
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING SUM(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY total_profit ASC
